name: tpl-existence-3-goal
task: Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly commands the agent to "Get into the locked room". This is a hard goal that must be represented by a clause, but the current clause set contains no Existence(target_room_entered). The Precedence clause only prevents picking up the ball before entering; it does not require the agent to enter the room. Add a hard Existence(target_room_entered) clause to capture the goal of reaching the locked room. The remaining clauses (hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up)) then correctly enforce the intended behavior.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard clause "The agent must eventually reach the locked room." (Existence(target_room_entered)) is redundant because it is already implied by the other hard rules: Existence(target_picked_up) together with Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up) forces the agent to enter the locked room before picking up the ball. Remove this clause and keep only the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and the hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause `Existence(target_room_entered)` is redundant because the hard rules `Existence(target_picked_up)` together with `Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up)` already enforce that the agent must enter the locked room. Remove the redundant `Existence(target_room_entered)` clause and keep the other two hard clauses.

texts: The agent must eventually enter the locked room.
The agent must eventually pick up the ball.
